description: A dated maintenance schedule for the equipment a household owns: furnace filters, smoke alarms, washing machine hoses, tank and tankless water heater flushing, refrigerator water filters, air purifier filters and humidifier wicks or panels. Each interval is the one the maker or body prints (ENERGY STAR, NFPA, IBHS, A.O. Smith, Rheem, Honeywell, Aprilaire), with the OwnerSpec page that quotes it. Give last-done dates for real due dates.

hard_water.description: True shortens the tank water heater flush to every 6 months (Rheem)

last_done.description: Equipment key or task id to the ISO date it was last done, e.g. {"furnace": "2026-07-01"}

name: plan_home_maintenance
title: Plan home equipment maintenance
